description: Change of use of upper floors above existing commercial unit to 2 x self-contained flats.
decision_conditions: In the absence of a noise assessment to evaluate the potential disturbance arising from the existing ground floor commercial activity and surrounding uses, the proposed development fails to demonstrate that the introduction of residential use above a commercial premises would not result in unacceptable noise impacts on future occupiers.

In the absence of such evidence, the proposal is considered to result in poor living conditions for future residents, contrary to policies 7 and 34 of the Local Plan, policies D6 and D14 of the London Plan and Paragraph 130(f) of the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF), as required under Class G of Part 3, Schedule 2 of the GPDO 2015 (as amended).

No details have been provided regarding the location, capacity, or method of collection for residential waste. Therefore, the proposed development fails to demonstrate adequate arrangements for the storage and management of domestic waste, as required under Class G of Part 3, Schedule 2 of the GPDO 2015 (as amended).

The proposed development fails to demonstrate compliance with the minimum floor-to-ceiling height requirement as set out in the Nationally Described Space Standards (NDSS), which apply to residential units created under Class G of Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
